segments.sn22.18:1.3: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn22.18:1.4: Aniccasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn22.18:1.6: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo vedanāya uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn22.18:1.7: Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, vedanā kuto niccā bhavissati!
segments.sn22.18:1.10: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo saṅkhārānaṃ uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn22.18:1.11: Aniccasambhūtā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā kuto niccā bhavissanti!
segments.sn22.18:1.13: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi anicco.
segments.sn22.18:1.14: Aniccasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn22.18:1.15: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
